profile.headline: Software Engineer at Electronic Arts
profile.summary:
Recent graduate of Cornell University majoring in Computer Science pursuing passion as a software engineer and application developer. Continuously improving skillset as a software developer and engaging with new technologies. Effective communicator and team player.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
●	Proficient in Java, Python, C++, C#, C, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, Angular, NodeJS, SQL, .NET Framework, Swift
●	Experienced with Git, Visual Studio, XCode, Azure DevOps Services, Twilio, Unity, Microsoft SQL Management Studio

positions.title: Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
●	Building and deploying features for internal and external applications in an agile development environment
●	Transforming technical information to be easily understandable and engaging to a corporate audience
 ●	Providing IT support and investigating production issues to meet business needs

positions.title: PlayStation Studio Production Intern - Sony Interactive Entertainment
positions.description:
●	Implemented the timely launch of new game titles by providing analysis on gameplay, narrative, UI, UX, bugs, etc. in the beta stage of the game production life cycle
●	Effectively collaborated with over 20 stakeholders in the studios including the Development Team and the User Experience Team in a fast-paced, team-based software development environment
●	Successfully presented my assignments to SIE’s top management
●	Designed and programmed a prototype game app involving biometric sensors in partnership with team for Sony’s corporate-wide 48-hour Hackathon; Used Unity and C#
●	Deepened understanding of game development process by shadowing multiple job functions including production and UX research within the Pixelopus studio

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description: Taught students to use Tinkercad to create 3D models and use 3D printing. Provided technology support for teachers. Feedback was strongly positive, e.g. “I wish you were here year-round”

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Game Design
